FN-QURQ145-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 234
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2024
Senate Bill 234 as introduced would expand the exemption from the competitive bidding
requirements, currently allowed for certain municipal public building authorities, to certain
county public building authorities that contract for the purchase of construction of certain plants,
buildings, or other facilities designed for industrial development. This could increase or
decrease the contract prices for the purchase or construction of such facilities by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in (1) the contract price procured under the
provisions of this act and (2) the contract price otherwise obtained under previous law.

FN-QURQ145-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 234
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 234 as passed the Senate could increase or decrease the obligations of county public
building authorities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: 1) the price
paid for certain facilities or equipment for industrial development exempted from competitive
bid laws by this bill, and 2) the cost otherwise paid by these authorities obtained from
competitive bid.
